data.one_liner: Simple API to format DateTime objects with custom format tokens.
data.what_it_does: The package exposes a formatDate function that takes a DateTime and a list of format tokens to produce a string. It supports many locales and time‑zone formatting.
use_when: Custom date patterns without external dependencies
avoid_when: Require complex date manipulation or arithmetic
strengths: Supports many locales (English, French, German, etc.)
weaknesses: Limited to DateTime, no Duration formatting
No support for custom locale data beyond provided ones
